name: Who We Turn Away
why_it_works: Saying who you are not for makes the right buyer feel chosen. Exclusion is a strong identity signal: when a brand turns some people away politely, the people it keeps feel the standard is real, and the post filters leads before they ever call.

hook.pattern: Open with a polite refusal: the brand states plainly that it is not for everyone, then lists who.
examples: We're not for everyone. Here's who we turn away.
Five people we politely say no to.
If this is you, {{brand}} isn't your fit.

craft.notes: Each refusal must be warm, not snobbish: say what you'll do instead (point them elsewhere). The 'why we say no' slide is the pivot that turns rules into a standard. Three refusals is the sweet spot; more starts to feel like a lecture.

do_not: Sound contemptuous of the people you turn away
Exclude anyone on protected traits such as age, race, religion or disability
Use refusals you don't actually enforce
compliance: Med spa: only say you turn away unsuitable candidates if a licensed provider makes that call; no before/after or result claims without a clear 'individual results vary' disclaimer
Law firms: declining a case is fine, but don't imply a case has no merit; follow your state bar's advertising rules
